uiDefinition.description: Enter the word Bearer, a space, then your ProofTell API key: Bearer pt_live_… or Bearer pt_test_…. Create a key in the ProofTell dashboard (Developers → Integrations), named after this platform. A pt_test_ key is the free sandbox: simulated, deterministic answers. A pt_live_ key spends the account's balance.
uiDefinition.tooltip: Bearer, a space, then the key (pt_live_… or pt_test_…)
